{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Hi Nisha, I'm Rohan Iyer. I've been having some really frustrating issues with my network coverage in my home area and my phone is acting up too.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these issues, Mr. Iyer. I know how frustrating it is when your service is unreliable.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Exactly. My phone number is 96707 41655. I just can't get a signal up there and the screen on my device is flickering constantly.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Let me check the network status for your area. One moment please.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I've already called three times this month. This is getting ridiculous.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I see there is some intermittent signal loss in your neighborhood. I will raise a network ticket to have our engineers investigate the local tower.", "tags": ["action:technician_or_ticket"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "A ticket? I just want it fixed now. And what about my flickering screen?", "tags": [""]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "For the device issue, I can book a device check at our nearest service center for you.", "tags": ["action:device_fix"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I have to go to a store? I can't believe this. I'm paying for a service that doesn't work and I'm using a phone that's broken!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I understand your frustration, but these are the standard procedures for these issues.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Standard procedures are not enough! This is completely unacceptable. I want to speak to your supervisor immediately.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I can certainly arrange that for you. Please hold while I transfer you to my manager.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Just do it now. I'm absolutely fed up with this.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Before I transfer you, is there anything else I can help you with? I have raised the network ticket and booked the device check. Goodbye for now.", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
